theater: 底比斯與玻俄提亞（希臘中部）

battle.name: 三督之亂
battle.theater: 底比斯與玻俄提亞（希臘中部）
battle.brief: 馬其頓王亞歷山大一世在底比斯安插三名僭主，斯巴達另設三百人議會；底比斯遂於公元前379年12月起事逐走他們，戰爭列表繫於前372年，實則前378年忒吉拉、科羅涅亞兩役後延續到前371年。卡面的希臘重步兵正是底比斯的筋骨：圓盾相接、矛林成列，五十列縱深壓散斯巴達莫拉。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 三督之亂的交戰方，表面上是中希臘的底比斯城邦聯盟對上伯羅奔尼撒的斯巴達聯盟，但開戰前真正主宰底比斯的，是馬其頓王亞歷山大一世安插的三名僭主——佩提達斯、梅隆尼奧斯與阿爾刻拉俄斯——以及斯巴達在海利阿爾圖斯之敗後用「十人寡頭」體系安插的「三百人議會」與城內駐軍。底比斯一方有完整的聯邦編制：十一個市鎮組成的議會約七十席，戰時由四名邦執政官分掌兵權、司法與祭祀，抽籤輪任，駐節底比斯城；聯邦另有三百名精騎「騎士團」，分四隊，每隊七十五人，由各邦執政官率領。斯巴達一方是王權與城邦機構分立的聯盟，國王阿基達利二世統帥，作戰骨幹是重裝步兵的莫拉營，一營約五六百人。雅典沒有直接用兵，卻是底比斯的靠山：第二雅典同盟在前378/7年成立，開俄斯、羅得斯、密提利尼、拜占庭與雅典聯手，雅典將軍卡布里阿斯在玻俄提亞活動，海軍與錢糧都朝底比斯傾斜。更遠處，波斯王宮也在盤算：前387/6年的「王之和平」讓斯巴達得以在玻俄提亞擺上寡頭，底比斯的起事正好掀開這道口子。
countriesEn: The two sides in the Revolt of the Three Tyrants were, on paper, the Boeotian League with its capital at Thebes in central Greece against the Spartan alliance of the Peloponnese. But in the months before the fighting, the real masters of Thebes were the three tyrants installed by Alexander I of Macedon — Peithidas, Melonius and Archelaus — together with the Council of Three Hundred and the city garrison that Sparta had planted after its defeat at Haliartus, using the system of decamarchies. The Theban side possessed a complete federal structure: a council of about seventy seats drawn from eleven towns, and in time of war four Boeotarchs who divided between them the command of the army, the courts and the sacrifices, chosen by lot and holding office in rotation, with their seat at the city of Thebes; the League also kept three hundred picked horsemen, the hippeis, in four squadrons of seventy-five, each under a Boeotarch. The Spartan side was an alliance in which royal power and civic institutions were kept apart, the army led by King Agesilaus II, and the fighting core the mora of heavy infantry, a unit of five or six hundred men. Athens did not fight, but she was Thebes' sponsor: the Second Athenian Confederacy was founded in 378/7 BC by Chios, Rhodes, Mytilene, Byzantium and Athens together, the Athenian general Chabrias was active in Boeotia, and the ships and the money both flowed towards Thebes. Further off, the court of Persia was doing its own arithmetic: the King's Peace of 387/6 BC had left Sparta free to set oligarchies in Boeotia, and the rising at Thebes prised that door open.
people: 這場戰爭的主角幾乎都是底比斯人。埃帕米諾達斯（約前418—前362）是統帥與政治家，他主張在城邦之上建聯邦、以長矛方陣配車兵作戰，後來把底比斯的國策推上全希臘的舞臺；起義歸國的伯羅皮達斯（約前380—前367）則是前線主帥，忒吉拉與科羅涅亞兩役的戰術都由他策劃。戈爾吉達斯是底比斯貴族，傳說中的「神聖隊」——三百名最精銳的重裝步兵——由他在前378年倡議組成，成為底比斯的招牌。底比斯另一位關鍵人物呂西馬科斯是城邦的領袖，被馬其頓扣作人質，國內的親斯巴達派因此有恃無恐。僭主一方是佩提達斯、梅隆尼奧斯、阿爾刻拉俄斯，其中佩提達斯倒戈，據說正是他與流亡者內應才使起事得以成功。馬其頓方面，安插僭主的是亞歷山大一世，他在前369年無嗣而卒，由佩爾狄卡斯三世攝幼年菲利普二世，並在前369/8年撥給底比斯流亡者三千名傭兵。斯巴達方面，出征的兩位王族近親是克勒俄姆布羅圖斯一世與克勒俄姆布羅圖斯二世，前者陣亡於忒吉拉，後者敗於科羅涅亞；國王阿基達利二世在玻俄提亞疲於奔命，最後在前371年主持和約。今天我們所知全靠三份材料：色諾芬《希臘史》第五卷、狄奧多羅斯《歷史叢書》第十五卷，以及普魯塔克《佩洛庇達斯傳》。
peopleEn: Almost every leading figure in this war was a Theban. Epaminondas (about 418–362 BC) was the general and the statesman: he held that a league should stand above the cities, and that a phalanx of pikes and a proper cavalry should fight for it, and he carried Theban policy on to the stage of all Greece. Pelopidas (about 380–367 BC), who came back from exile at the head of the rising, was the commander in the field, and the tactics of Tegyra and of Coronea were his work. Gorgidas was a Theban aristocrat, credited with the Sacred Band — three hundred of the best heavy infantry — organised in 378 BC, which became the token of the city. Another decisive Theban was Lysimachus, the leader of the commonwealth, who was held hostage by Macedon, so that the pro-Spartan party inside the city could act with impunity. On the tyrants' side stood Peithidas, Melonius and Archelaus, and Peithidas turned: by the common account it was his collusion with the exiles that made the rising possible. On the Macedonian side, Alexander I had installed the tyrants; he died in 369 BC without issue, and Perdiccas III then governed as regent for the boy Philip II, handing three thousand mercenaries to the Theban exiles in 369/8 BC. On the Spartan side the two royal near relations who marched were Cleombrotus I and Cleombrotus II, the first killed at Tegyra, the second beaten at Coronea, while King Agesilaus II wore himself out in Boeotia and finally presided over the peace in 371 BC. All that survives of the war comes from three books: the fifth book of Xenophon's Hellenica, the fifteenth book of Diodorus Siculus, and Plutarch's Life of Pelopidas.
kits: 卡面這名希臘重步兵，正是這場戰爭的筋骨。底比斯與斯巴達的正面交鋒，最後都落在一列列重裝步兵的方陣上：圓盾（aspis）直徑約九十厘米，內襯木板、蒙皮，外緣包青銅，左臂穿入握把與腕帶，既護住身體又覆蓋右鄰的肩背，方陣的厚度就這樣疊出來；頭戴青銅科林斯式或較晚的開放式頭盔，護頰與頸甲並用；身穿亞麻或皮革的束腰胸甲，也有鍛造的「肌肉胸甲」，配青銅或皮革護脛與垂甲片；主兵器是約二至二點四米長的長矛（dory），梣木杆、青銅或鐵矛頭，必要時夾在腋下再刺出；副兵器是雙刃短劍（xiphos）與用皮帶擲出的投槍（amentum）。一整套裝備沉重而昂貴，底比斯以公帑供給少年兵與神聖隊的裝備，城內武器庫設在卡德米亞山丘的軍械庫中。編制上，底比斯作戰時用上各城鎮抽調的公民重裝步兵、三百人的神聖隊、三百名少年兵（ephebes）、弓箭手與輕裝散兵（peltasts），以及三百名聯邦騎兵；斯巴達那邊則是重裝步兵莫拉營，每營約五六百人，兩翼配騎兵與少量皮洛特斯。重步兵之間的勝負，最後往往不是比體力，而是比誰能把縱深、掩護與進攻次序排好。
kitsEn: The Greek hoplite on the card is precisely the backbone of this war. The decisive clashes between Thebes and Sparta came down in the end to rank upon rank of heavy infantry: the round shield, the aspis, about ninety centimetres across, lined with boards and covered with hide, its rim sheathed in bronze, the left arm passed through the grip and the arm-band, so that it guarded the body and at the same time covered the shoulder and back of the man on the right, and the thickness of the phalanx was built up out of exactly that. On the head was a bronze Corinthian helmet, or the later open-faced type, with cheek pieces and a neck guard; on the body a linen or leather corselet, and in other cases a hammered muscle cuirass, with bronze or leather greaves and a skirt of strips. The main weapon was the dory, a pike about two to two and a half metres long, with an ash shaft and a bronze or iron head, held under the arm and driven out in the last stretch; secondary weapons were the double-edged short sword, the xiphos, and the javelin thrown with a leather strap, the amentum. A full set of this equipment was heavy and costly, and Thebes equipped the ephebes and the Sacred Band from the public purse, with the armourers' stores kept in the arsenal of the Cadmea citadel. In the order of battle Thebes used citizen hoplites drawn from the towns of the League, the three hundred of the Sacred Band, three hundred ephebes, archers and light-armed peltasts, and the three hundred cavalry of the League; on the Spartan side, the mora of heavy infantry, five or six hundred men to a unit, with cavalry on the wings and a few peltasts. The issue between armies of heavy infantry was rarely settled by strength of body, but by who could arrange depth, cover and the order of attack.
tactics: 起事本身就是一套戰術。公元前379年12月，底比斯議會開會之日，佩提達斯與回城的流亡者聯手，在城內奪取武器庫、攻破斯巴達「三百人議會」與駐軍據守的卡德米亞要塞，殲滅對方首腦，放走被扣押的戰俘，隨即召開公民大會重建民主；全城同時對外封閉，擊潰聞訊而來的斯巴達援兵。首戰是忒吉拉（前378年3月，底比斯西南約二十公里，喀忒戎山麓的樹林地帶，官道之旁）。三百名神聖隊與三百名少年兵埋伏在谷地坡上，斯巴達莫拉縱隊行軍，縱深一旦被拉長，盾牌就再也接不成一片；底比斯自側翼高處下衝，聯邦騎兵在兩翼追擊潰兵，克勒俄姆布羅圖斯一世陣亡，斯巴達軍被連根拔起，底比斯奪其營寨、盔甲與糧秣，並在現場立下戰利品紀念碑。斯巴達再整軍進攻，同年八月科羅涅亞之戰，底比斯把方陣縱深加到五十列，並把最厚的一端放在左翼，專打斯巴達右翼；斯巴達企圖用「反勾陣」把對手的縱深削薄，底比斯不進不退，任其勾動之後再收攏重組，伯羅皮達斯率神聖隊擊穿斯巴達右翼，莫拉崩潰。此後底比斯靠騎兵劫掠阿提卡鄉野、以聯盟海軍監視伯羅奔尼撒海岸、以圍困與斷糧消耗斯巴達遠征軍，直到前371年和約才停手。
tacticsEn: The rising was itself a piece of tactics. In December 379 BC, on the day the council of Thebes met, Peithidas and the returned exiles acted together: they seized the armoury inside the city, broke the Spartan Council of Three Hundred and the garrison in the Cadmea citadel, killed the opposing leaders, released the prisoners held inside the walls, and then called a citizens' assembly to reconstitute the democracy; at the same moment the city shut its gates and beat off a Spartan relief column sent in answer. The first battle was Tegyra (March 378 BC, about twenty kilometres south-west of Thebes, among the wooded ground at the foot of Mount Cithaeron, beside the great road). Three hundred of the Sacred Band and three hundred ephebes lay in ambush on the slope of the valley while the Spartan mora marched in column, and once a column is stretched out its shields can no longer be locked together. The Thebans came down from the high ground on the flank, the cavalry of the League rode the fugitives down on both wings, Cleombrotus I was killed, the Spartan army was uprooted, and Thebes took its camp, its armour and its baggage, setting up a trophy of the spoils on the spot. Sparta reformed and came again: at the battle of Coronea in August of the same year Thebes deepened the phalanx to fifty ranks and put its thickest end on the left, aimed straight at the Spartan right. The Spartans tried to counter the deep order by scooping their own lines to thin the Theban front; the Thebans refused to be drawn, held their ground, and then closed up and reorganised, and Pelopidas with the Sacred Band broke through the Spartan right and the mora came apart. After that Thebes harried the countryside of Attica with its cavalry, watched the coasts of the Peloponnese with the allied fleet, and wore down the Spartan expeditionary armies by investment and by cutting their supplies, until the peace of 371 BC ended the war.
data: 可核對的數字分幾類。時間一類最清楚：起事在公元前379年12月（色諾芬記為底比斯議會召開之日，後世多定於12月22日），忒吉拉在前378年3月（多定於3月26日），科羅涅亞在前378年8月，和約在前371年，前370年底比斯進軍拉科尼亞，前362年曼提涅亞之戰後全希臘再無大戰。兵力一類：忒吉拉一役，底比斯投入的是三百名神聖隊加三百名少年兵，另有各城鎮的公民兵；色諾芬記斯巴達方面全軍約一千人，陣亡也約一千人，其中斯巴達公民約二百五十人，底比斯方面的損失極輕。編制一類：神聖隊三百人，聯邦騎兵三百人分四隊，邦執政官四名、議會約七十席、十一市鎮，科羅涅亞的底比斯方陣縱深五十列（普魯塔克語）。後勤與財政一類：狄奧多羅斯記前369/8年馬其頓佩爾狄卡斯撥給底比斯流亡者三千名傭兵；雅典第二同盟的錢糧是底比斯遠征的支柱；底比斯遠征拉科尼亞的軍數，後世記為數萬人，狄奧多羅斯的七萬之數顯有誇張。距離一類：底比斯至忒吉拉約二十公里，至斯巴達沿官道約二百五十公里，可作行軍與補給的參照。前371年之後，底比斯在阿提卡留駐三百名守軍，這支部隊在三十餘年後的演說中仍被提及。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall into several classes. Chronology is the clearest: the rising took place in December 379 BC (Xenophon has it on the day the council of Thebes met, and later writers usually settle on 22 December), Tegyra came in March 378 BC (usually 26 March), Coronea in August 378 BC, the peace in 371 BC, the Theban entry into Laconia in 370 BC, and after the battle of Mantinea in 362 BC there was no great war left in Greece. Numbers of men: at Tegyra Thebes committed three hundred of the Sacred Band and three hundred ephebes, with citizen hoplites from the towns besides; Xenophon puts the whole Spartan force at about a thousand and the Spartan dead at about a thousand as well, of whom some two hundred fifty were Spartan citizens, while the Theban losses were very light. Establishments: the Sacred Band three hundred, the cavalry of the League three hundred in four squadrons, four Boeotarchs, a council of about seventy seats, eleven towns, and at Coronea a Theban phalanx fifty ranks deep, in Plutarch's words. Logistics and finance: Diodorus records that in 369/8 BC Perdiccas of Macedon gave three thousand mercenaries to the Theban exiles; the money of the Second Athenian Confederacy was the prop of the Theban campaigns; the strength of the Theban army that marched into Laconia is given by later writers as tens of thousands, and the figure of seventy thousand in Diodorus is plainly exaggerated. Distances: about twenty kilometres from Thebes to Tegyra, and about two hundred fifty kilometres by the great road from Thebes to Sparta, both usable as references for marching and supply. After 371 BC Thebes left a garrison of three hundred men in Attica, a force still mentioned in a speech delivered some thirty years later.
cause: 打起來的原因有四層。第一層是斯巴達的體制安排：公元前395年海利阿爾圖斯之敗後，斯巴達在玻俄提亞各城安插「十人寡頭」，底比斯被壓到只剩三百人議會，重大決定不經公民；斯巴達要的正是一個聽話、有產出、又不會與自己爭霸的玻俄提亞。第二層是馬其頓的介入：亞歷山大一世扣押底比斯領袖呂西馬科斯作人質，並安插三名僭主，底比斯的政治命脈落在外邦手裡，國人既憤怒又無力。第三層是起義的內應：流亡在外的伯羅皮達斯等人拉攏了佩提達斯與城內的民主派，約定在議會召開之日同時動手；亞歷山大的死訊與斯巴達注意力的轉移，給了起事一個窗口。第四層是聯盟的形勢：第二雅典同盟成立，底比斯有了海軍、錢糧與盟邦，於是敢於先發制人；斯巴達若不在玻俄提亞把局勢壓住，其霸權就會被聯盟在海上與西部同時挖開。戰略上，底比斯城牆高、卡德米亞要塞易守難攻，城內的武器庫與公民的組織力，使「一次成功的城內起事」成為可能，而底比斯恰好握有足以野戰的城邦重裝步兵。
causeEn: There were four layers of reason behind the fighting. The first was the arrangement made by Sparta: after the defeat at Haliartus in 395 BC the Spartans set decamarchies in the cities of Boeotia, and Thebes was reduced to a Council of Three Hundred through which no major decision passed; what Sparta wanted in Boeotia was a docile, productive region that would not compete with it for hegemony. The second was the intervention of Macedon: Alexander I held the Theban leader Lysimachus hostage and installed the three tyrants, so that the political life of Thebes lay in the hands of a foreign power, and the citizens were angry but helpless. The third was the collusion that made the rising possible: exiles such as Pelopidas won over Peithidas and the democratic party inside the city and agreed on the day of the council meeting to strike together; the news of Alexander's death and the turning of Spartan attention elsewhere gave the rising its opening. The fourth was the shape of the alliances: with the Second Athenian Confederacy in existence Thebes had ships, money and allies, and dared to strike first; if Sparta did not crush the situation in Boeotia, its hegemony would be picked apart at once by the confederacy at sea and in the west. Tactically, the high walls of Thebes, the awkward strength of the Cadmea citadel, the armourers' stores inside the walls and the organising capacity of the citizens made a successful rising in the city possible, and Thebes happened to hold the citizen heavy infantry needed to fight in the open country as well.
impact: 三督之亂的結果，是斯巴達霸權的終結。公元前371年的和約讓底比斯在玻俄提亞聯邦中取得領袖地位，伯羅奔尼撒聯盟隨之瓦解；前370年底比斯進軍拉科尼亞，美塞尼亞復國，阿卡迪亞聯盟成立，希臘城邦從此走上聯邦化的道路，這條路後來通向呂庫古改革，也通向城邦之間無休止的聯盟外交。戰術上的影響更為持久：五十列縱深、斜著進攻、佯攻與正攻交替、以退為進的戰役法，以及精銳常備隊的「神聖隊」體制，都成了希臘兵的教科；菲利普二世這些年在底比斯做人質，從埃帕米諾達斯與伯羅皮達斯的戰場上學到的那一套，後來被鑄進馬其頓方陣——前338年喀耳刻尼翁之戰，馬其頓把右翼交給底比斯與神聖隊，正是這種師承的延續。政治上，這場起事把「城邦自由」的口號推到極致，底比斯解放美塞尼亞、推翻受斯巴達扶植的寡頭，卻自己也用聯邦的權力壓住各城，理想與現實的落差成為後世悲劇的雛形。最後，前362年曼提涅亞，埃帕米諾達斯中重傷而死，底比斯霸權僅維持了不到十年；這場戰爭播下的種子，收成歸了北方的馬其頓。
impactEn: The outcome of the Revolt of the Three Tyrants was the end of Spartan hegemony. The peace of 371 BC gave Thebes the leading place in the Boeotian League, and the Peloponnesian League came apart with it; when Thebes marched into Laconia in 370 BC, Messenia was restored as a state and the Arcadian League was founded, and from that point the Greek cities went down the road of federal union, a road that later led to the reforms of Lycurgus and to an endless diplomacy of alliances among cities. The influence on tactics was the more durable of the two: the fifty-rank depth, the oblique advance, the alternation of feint and true attack, the campaign method of yielding in order to advance, and the institution of a permanent picked corps in the Sacred Band all became textbooks for Greek soldiers. Philip II spent his years in Thebes as a hostage, and what he learned there on the fields of Epaminondas and Pelopidas was afterwards cast into the Macedonian phalanx: at Chaeronea in 338 BC the right wing of the Macedonian army was handed to the Thebans and to the Sacred Band, and there the succession of the school can be seen at work. Politically, the rising pushed the slogan of the freedom of the cities to its limit, for Thebes freed Messenia and overturned the oligarchies backed by Sparta, while itself holding the towns down with the power of the League; the gap between the ideal and the reality became the embryo of later tragedy. In the end, at Mantinea in 362 BC Epaminondas was mortally wounded and died, and the Theban hegemony had lasted barely ten years; the seed sown by this war was harvested by Macedon to the north.

resultEn: The rising inside the city succeeded in December 379 BC: the three tyrants were driven out, the Spartan Council of Three Hundred and the garrison in the citadel were killed or expelled, and Thebes called a citizens' assembly to reconstitute its democracy; that step was the hinge of the whole war. Over the next two years Thebes destroyed a Spartan mora at Tegyra with three hundred of the Sacred Band and three hundred ephebes, and broke the Spartan right at Coronea with a phalanx fifty ranks deep. For the first time the Spartan heavy infantry was beaten this thoroughly in a frontal clash, and the allies of Sparta turned to Thebes one after another: the League grew quickly, the Athenians and their confederacy came in, and the cities of the Peloponnese began to demand autonomy. The Peace was concluded in 371 BC and Sparta recognised Thebes as the leading power; in 370 BC the Theban coalition entered Laconia, and the Spartan hegemony broke apart for good. The war did not truly end with that peace: in 369/8 BC the exiles returned with three thousand mercenaries, and the Third Sacred War of Phocis between 356 and 346 BC dragged all Greece into fighting again, until at Mantinea in 362 BC Epaminondas was mortally wounded and the Theban hegemony came to its close. For the weapon on this card the meaning of the war is direct: what decided Tegyra and Coronea was the formation and the equipment of the heavy infantry — the thickness of shields locked together, the fifty ranks of depth, the weight of the pike forest and of the cuirasses. Without that weapon Thebes could neither hold the city nor win in the open field.
